t: The DEWALT DT42335TZ-QZ metal cutting discs are engineered for efficient and precise cutting with angle grinders. These durable 115mm discs are essential for general metalwork, making light work of demanding tasks on site or in the workshop. Constructed with professional-grade aluminium oxide grain, these tough discs are ideal for cutting all types of steel, including stainless steel. A premium resin bond and reinforced fibreglass enhance life length and durability, while the 1.2mm blade thickness ensures clean cuts. An open, non-woven structure increases flexibility and reduces heat build-up during operation. Suitable for both wet and dry applications. The 10-pack is supplied in a handy tin for convenient storage and protection.
